text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page triggered for service=redwood-inference-api env=prod region=us-west-2 metric=5xx_rate threshold=0.08 current=0.26
pagerbot: page fired -> @emma_oncall, escalation level=1
emma_oncall: acked. I'm looking. Can someone post the error histogram and a quick count by endpoint?
raj: putting up the dashboard: high spike centered on /v1/generate and /v1/chat, 5xx primarily 502/503. 1min error rate ~26% across us-west-2.
sophia: logs show repeated "upstream response error" from model-router and model-worker oom/killed events around the same time.
miguel: I'm seeing a sudden surge in tokens/sec from a handful of API keys — looks like a customer-side job ramped up. throttling not triggered because it's spread across routes.
emma_oncall: ok, possible traffic storm + some worker instability. Initial impact: increased latency and 5xx for some requests, not all customers but a noticeable fraction.
infra-bot: autoscaler attempted to scale pool-model-x but failed to attach new instances due to AMI boot timeout (EC2 init script error).
raj: here's a tail of model-worker logs:
```
2026-03-14T10:08:42Z model-worker[pid:1234] ERROR: KV cache OOM, evicted 128 entries
2026-03-14T10:09:01Z model-worker[pid:1234] CRITICAL: process killed by OOM-killer
2026-03-14T10:09:03Z model-router ERROR: upstream response error: connection reset
```
emma_oncall: thanks. Plan: 1) mute noisy client while we stabilize, 2) reduce concurrency per worker to avoid OOMs, 3) attempt graceful restart of a subset of model-workers, 4) open status page if impact persists.
sophia: I can cut the client key rate temporarily (WAF/ratelimit). Which key? Miguel, can you point to the API key IDs?
miguel: keys: ak_live_17... (top offender), ak_live_42... (secondary). Sending to #sre-private with IPs.
emma_oncall: miguel please block ak_live_17 in the routing layer (temporary throttle to 2rps) and add a 5m rule.
miguel: done. throttle rule applied: ak_live_17 -> 2 rps. error rate drops slightly to 18%.
raj: starting a rolling restart of the model-worker group (10% at a time) with reduced concurrency env var ML_WORKER_MAX_CONCURRENCY=6.
infra-bot: rolling restart triggered on model-worker-group-us-west-2, batch_size=10%, min_healthy=80%
emma_oncall: monitoring latency and 5xx. If restarts don't help within 10m we'll spin a smaller instance type that uses less memory.
sophia: quick mitigation suggestion: enable prefix/KV cache bypass for long contexts to reduce memory pressure on workers handling huge token loops. Can toggle via config flag.
raj: toggled prefix_kv_cache=false for model-workers in us-west-2. Applying to 20% of pool first.
miguel: after changes, error rate down to ~7% and stabilizing. Latency back to normal for most traffic.
emma_oncall: good. I'll keep monitoring for 15m. We should still confirm root cause: why did autoscaler fail to add capacity?
infra-bot: autoscaler error: "InstanceLaunchTimeout: cloud-init script exceeded 300s" for 4 instances. Investigating AMI init scripts.
raj: follow-up action: revert the last init script change from 2026-03-13 that added extra package installs. Rolling back to previous init artifact.
emma_oncall: agree. Also we need a post-incident ticket for: 1) tighten per-key rate limits for large-model routes, 2) add autoscaler retries for InstanceLaunchTimeout, 3) rollback/change to init scripts, 4) add better KV cache eviction metrics.
sophia: creating ticket now: INF-5472 "March 14th us-west 5xx spike: autoscaler + OOM cascade" and adding assignees raj, miguel, infra.
statuspage-bot: draft status page created (private) — please review. public page not yet published.
emma_oncall: handing over to raj for deeper infra follow-up. my oncall window ends in 25m. I'll remain available for urgent pings. Handoff notes: mitigations applied: client ak_live_17 throttled, concurrency reduced, rolling restart and prefix_kv_cache toggle. Current status: error rate ~5-8%, gradually decreasing.
raj: taking over. I'll keep the thread updated and escalate to platform if we see another uptick. Planned next steps: run postmortem once infra rollback validated, increase autoscaler timeout + retries, add automated detection to throttle single-key token storms.
miguel: I'll prepare a summary for customer-facing support with a list of affected time windows and services.
emma_oncall: thanks team. Marking incident as "stabilized" but not resolved. Reopen if >10% 5xx again. :thumbsup:
pagerbot: escalation cleared to level=0 — no active page.
statuspage-bot: scheduled public update pending review.
raj: note to self — check image-builder logs for the init change at 2026-03-13T22:11Z and snapshot the broken AMI for debugging.
emma_oncall: end handoff.
